response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure work, and recent exposure to MCP and agentic tooling. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python usage, no cloud-platform AI system design, no vector database or RAG experience, no data pipeline work for AI, and no multi-agent framework experience — all of which are core, required qualifications for this Staff FDE GenAI role. The GenAI/MCP exposure is only 4 months old and described vaguely, making it hard to assess depth against an 8-year AI-specific experience bar.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (15+ years) with strong technical range
Recent hands-on involvement with MCP and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq
Track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and cross-domain problem solving
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience; primary stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or AI-focused data pipelines
GenAI/agentic experience appears very recent (since April 2025) and lacks depth or production-scale detail

key_factors.factor: Lack of RAG/vector DB and AI data pipeline experience
No Python experience shown; language mismatch with required stack
Recent MCP/agentic workflow exposure at re:cinq
